{{Top|leg}}
'''Squad Six''' was a squad of [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]] serving in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Their vessels bore gray markings to identify their squad affiliation.
